body.title: No blanket robots.txt blocks on AI crawler user-agents

untrusted_site_text.prompt:
### No blanket robots.txt blocks on AI crawler user-agents

- **Check:** [AIR-1.1](https://readinessindex.io/open-standard#air-1.1) (failed gate)
- **Worth:** 4 points
- **Effort:** small

**What the scan found.** An example finding.

**What the scan recorded.** Nothing the scan could point at — this check is about something it could not see on the pages it read.

**How it is measured.**

> Parse `robots.txt`. Evaluate each of `GPTBot`, `OAI-SearchBot`, `ChatGPT-User`, `ClaudeBot`, `Claude-User`, `PerplexityBot`, `Google-Extended`, `Applebot-Extended`, `CCBot`, `Bytespider` against the rule set. Resolve `User-agent: *` fallbacks correctly, including the longest-match group rule.

**What to change.** An example finding.

**What full marks look like.**

> Every listed agent may fetch content paths.
